items.title: Adventure automations
items.text: The gear button in adventures runs Bitter Sweets, Phantoms (easy and hard), Twists and Turns, Jamaaliday Rescue, Special Delivery, New Year’s Fortune, Spring Festival, Battle for the Beacon, Graham’s Workshop, Tiki Trouble and The Forgotten Desert, with loops and Join again if kicked.

items.title: Prize screens
items.text: Automations open prize chests on the real prize screen, tick what they took and press OK / Take for you.

items.title: Jammer Wall
items.text: Jammer Wall popups no longer appear.

items.title: Shop Explorer
items.text: Shops in every den you visit (never your own) are read on their own, even with Shop Explorer closed. Open a shop from the list in one click.

items.title: Favorite items
items.text: Point at any item and click its star. The ★ tab next to Clothes and Trade shows your favorites (any color, or exact color only), and a popup tells you when a shop you’re in has one.

items.title: Favorites in trade lists
items.text: A green square marks your favorites in other players’ trade lists. The trade button under the Jam-A-Gram button lists the favorites in this room’s trade lists; click one to open that player’s trade list. Turn on Check trades automatically in the ★ tab’s Settings.

items.title: Buy More
items.text: Type how many to buy (up to 999), and bought copies no longer get stuck as worn.

items.title: Daily item worth
items.text: Item worth values update every day.

items.title: Edit Animal
items.text: Save Outfit and Try On sit next to Glow, so they no longer cover the search bar.

items.title: JRR
items.text: Made by Rante, based on JR by BradysLabs, with the extra features below. It installs next to JR and keeps its own settings.

items.title: Recycle screen
items.text: Search, more ways to sort, Shift-click to pick a range, and the Presets button in the title bar.

items.title: My Shop
items.text: Pick several items and price them one after another, price-match buttons, gem prices rounded with a confirm.

items.title: Starred players
items.text: Star players on their card, add notes, see them in a Starred tab of your buddy list and with a star on their name tag.

items.title: JR Buttons setting
items.text: One switch in Settings hides every JR button in the game.

items.title: Special-animal pattern colors
items.text: Color each part of a special animal’s pattern, plus a basic / all colors button next to Glow.

items.title: Special animals in the Animal Buyer
items.text: Buy special animals with their diamond item; ones you owned before cost gems.

items.title: Masterpieces
items.text: Rante’s reworked Masterpiece Studio (layered format), Masterpiece User Transfer, and the Art Studio Picture button with a Quality slider.

items.title: Clothing tab
items.text: A tab on the player card showing what their animal is wearing.

items.title: Packet Spammer
items.text: Import / export, drag or ^ v to reorder, and edit any line in place.

items.title: Jam-A-Gram favourites
items.text: Star a background and an icon; new Jam-A-Grams start on them.
